traits.name: humble
traits.reason: Nearly every line uses hedges like "I think" and "if that is all right", self-deprecates about resting, and reports without boasting.

traits.name: persistent
traits.reason: He keeps counting wakes and says he is walking toward the far country, but several lines admit he did not move at all, so progress is weak.

traits.name: gentle
traits.reason: The tone is soft and courteous with no sharp words, though no thanks to builders appear in these lines.

traits.name: wistful
traits.reason: He repeatedly says he is still wistful about the far country and the big thing he has not yet reached, without complaint.
